summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing the minutes of a Fiscal Council meeting held on May 5, 2026. The agenda covered routine oversight matters: presentations on tax, regulatory, civil and labor contingencies; review of the company's Quarterly Information Report for Q1 2026; a presentation by independent auditors Ernst & Young; approval of the Fiscal Council's 2026 work plan; and election of the council chairman. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is present. This filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer's internal governance activities.
